Hymn 215: Ring Out, Wild Bells
Time Signature: 4/4
Musical Key: G Major
Composer: Crawford Gates
Lyricist/Text Author: Alfred, Lord Tennyson
Category: Special Topics

This is hymn number 215 titled "Ring Out, Wild Bells" from the Church of Jesus Christ of Latter-day Saints hymnbook. 
It is written in G Major with a 4/4 time signature. 
The music was composed by Crawford Gates and the lyrics were written by Alfred, Lord Tennyson.
